name: credentials-basic
description: External credentials provider: the four BASIC backends of workbench - the process environment, a JSON/YAML credentials file, the project .env and the user .env - implementing credentials@1 for the provider ids env/file/project-env/user-env

config.description: Every backend registers with its DEFAULTS when its sub-object is absent; the plugin resolves credential NAMES against the environment / files / credential store at RUNTIME, so this repository holds no secret value.

env.description: The direct process environment. No config keys (an unknown key is a loud config error).

path.description: Credentials file (resolved against the config directory); default credentials.json

dir.description: Project directory (default: the config file directory)
